derivation: A budget-backed operation step's matching effect carries a collection its completion carrier does not declare, so the record is completion-mismatched and the lifecycle classification is UNEXPECTED. LIFE-010 defines observed_request from the evidence fields alone: it is the dispatch-attributed request when every completion binding maps the actual fields back to that exact request, and null only when a field is missing, extra, inconsistent or unprojectable; RES-WIRE-003 calls it the complete operation-field projection when that projection is possible. The fields here project exactly, so the embedded record keeps the projected request with completion_mismatch true and mismatch_reason UNEXPECTED_EFFECT. The registry retains the fact as disputed exposure, blocking the reservation's original partition, which is also the projected one; the occurrence becomes OUTCOME_UNKNOWN and LIFE-006 adds BUDGET_EFFECT_DISPUTED and the receipt reason to UNEXPECTED_EFFECT.
